meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 扫描已部署的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源,生成按功能排列的可靠性清单(可用区冗余、存储、健康探测、多区域故障转移),并在你确认后分阶段修改配置。
howto.when: 当你说出 “assess reliability”、“reliability posture” 等关键词,或要求检查、开启 Functions 与 App Service 的可用区冗余、多区域故障转移等时触发。

say.text: 评估我这个资源组的可靠性状态
say.note: 会返回按功能排列的清单

say.text: 我的应用服务计划是可用区冗余的吗?

say.note: 会先列出改动并等你确认

howto.what_en: Scans your deployed Azure Functions and App Service resources and returns a feature-based reliability checklist (zone redundancy, storage, health probes, multi-region failover), then makes staged configuration changes after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “assess reliability,” “reliability posture,” or similar, or ask to check or enable zone redundancy or multi-region failover for Azure Functions and App Service.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my resource group
Is my App Service plan zone redundant?
Enable zone redundancy for my app
say_en.note: Lists changes and waits for confirmation
